Task #1023: Reopen and retitle on the files board

## Goal

Make the files board (`TEAMWORK_BOARD=files`) follow the GitHub board's usage pattern, reopening a closed backlog or task first, as the owner asked in https://github.com/kalaluthien/mumu-claude-plugin/issues/1022.

- **Reopen**: a `reopen` board operation in `protocol.md`'s table, a row in both board adapters, `board_files.reopen` and `board_github.reopen`, and `use-board.py reopen <issue>`; on both boards a reopened issue reads `state: OPEN`, `stateReason: REOPENED`, `closedAt: None`, as GitHub answers (sandbox probe on `kalaluthien/teamwork-board-sandbox#42`: `["open","reopened",null]`). `manager.md`'s closed-backlog row names `reopen`, since it says "reopen that backlog" with no operation behind it today.
- **Retitle**: `manager.md` rewrites a backlog's title at each material scope change; `board-github.md` does it by `gh issue edit --title`, the files board has no way. Add `use-board.py title <issue> <title>` on both boards, named in both adapters' `edit` rows, its title length read by `board_files.command`, so the title hook guards it as it guards `gh issue edit --title`.
- **Refusals as GitHub refuses**: sandbox probes (`kalaluthien/teamwork-board-sandbox#42`-`#48`) showed GitHub refuse, each 422 unless named: a second parent (`Sub issue may only have one parent`, the same parent again included), an issue nested under itself (`Sub issue cannot be the same as the parent issue`), an issue blocked by itself (`Target issue cannot be the same as the source issue`), the same blocker twice (`Target issue has already been taken`), and removing a label the issue lacks (`Label does not exist`, 404); it accepts adding a label twice (kept once) and reopening an open issue (`already open`, exit 0, `state_reason` unchanged). The files board accepts each refused case silently today (`teamwork/lib/board_files.py:123-133`). Each refuses on the files board, writing nothing; a missing issue stays refused, as today.
- **Scenario**: `fixtures/replay-board-scenario.py` gains the steps `retitle`, `reopen` (the resolved backlog), `nest-again` (a new task under it) and `resolve-again`, so the same-result diff covers the new scenario on both boards.
- **Hook sees the new writes**: `board_files.command` matches `use-board.py reopen` and `use-board.py title`, as `board_github.command` matches any `gh issue` write, so the hook's title guard and reminders reach them.
- Builds on #865 (files board, scenario) and #1019/#1020 (board setting read).
